title: Monitor all AI activity with the unified trace table (Beta)
body:
The unified trace table is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). It captures every request and response across your Unity AI Gateway services into one Unity Catalog table in OpenTelemetry format, giving you a single place to monitor, debug, secure, and audit all AI activity.

See [Monitor all AI activity using the unified trace table](/aws/en/ai-gateway/unified-trace-table).
